summary: DEEP AUDIT run at a 390x844 viewport as phone 9000000001. Screens visited: entry, Home, JEE hub, Mock and Chapter catalogue, set detail, attempt player (Kinematics), result, Solutions tab, My Tests, Live JEE, Mission, Account, Rapid hub, a full 30-card solo session to its summary, an all-skip session, a full AI Rival duel to its result, and Shop (Avatars, Frames, Arenas). Backend: 52 of 52 regression tests pass when run serially; under xdist one test fails because it depends on test order. A new audit script scanned all 11,498 rf_cards. Structure is clean: 4 options on every card, every answer index in range, no duplicate options, no empty explanations, no unbalanced LaTeX, and answer positions are balanced. Content problems: about 1 in 27 sampled cards has a wrong answer key, 20 prompts appear twice, and about 35 cards say 'Both A and B' even though their options were shuffled. Speed: every screen showed real data in 0.3-0.95 s, with no duplicate or waterfall API calls. The slow items are the mandatory device check (2.3-2.8 s) and the 263 KB result payload. Game layer: the reward panel has count-up, a particle burst and a chest. But the AI Rival is rigged to always lose, there are no answer or result sounds, haptics are the same for correct and wrong answers, and you can skip all 30 cards and still keep your streak and count toward the daily quest. Deprecated packages: none (expo-audio is used, not expo-av). SafeArea: insets used correctly. I fixed one trivial bug: the solo summary header showed the last card's chapter.

ranked_findings.finding: The AI Rival is hard-capped at your score minus 1, and winner() hands the human the win whenever their score is above 0. Getting 1 card right out of 30 is a guaranteed 'You won!'. There is no tension, and wins mean nothing.
ranked_findings.fix: Use adaptive difficulty. Set bot accuracy from the learner's last 5 sessions (plus or minus 10%) and a pace of about 4-7 s per card, aiming for a 55-65% human win rate. Let winner() compare real scores and then ms, as it does for human duels.

ranked_findings.finding: In a hand-checked random sample of 54 cards, 2 answer keys are wrong (about 3.7%, which projects to roughly 400 bad cards). (a) The circle x²+y²+2gx+2fy+c=0 touches the y-axis when f²=c, but the key and formula say g²=c. (b) The lanthanoid with a stable +4 state from a half-filled 4f is Tb (4f⁸ → Tb⁴⁺ 4f⁷), but the key says Gd.
ranked_findings.fix: Run an automated second-pass verification: an LLM re-solves each card blind, and any card where it disagrees with the key is flagged and quarantined (add a review_status filter in the rf_create $match). Add an in-card 'Report wrong answer' button that writes to an rf_reports collection.

ranked_findings.where: rf_cards options (about 35 cards). Examples: 549c3e68, 6153d064, 26f9941e, cc0b9128, f70b7258
ranked_findings.finding: Options such as 'Both A and B', 'Both A & C' and 'All of these' were shuffled, so the letters now point at the wrong options. Example: ∫tan x dx has the options ['sec²x+C', 'ln|sec x|+C', 'Both A and B', '−ln|cos x|+C'] and the key is 'Both A and B', which is wrong.
ranked_findings.fix: Rewrite these as explicit text ('Both ln|sec x| and −ln|cos x|'), or pin them as the last option. Regex used: (both [A-D]|[A-D] (and|&) [A-D]|all of the above|none of these).

ranked_findings.finding: A solo session where all 30 cards are skipped (0 answered) still counts as a sprint. It increments sessions and day_stats.sprints, so the 'Finish 1 Solo Sprint' quest pays +30 coins, and it keeps the daily streak and the 'first_sprint' badge. The UI then plays the chest and burst animation for '+0 XP'.
ranked_findings.fix: Give streak, quest and session credit only when answered >= 10 (or correct >= 5). When the reward is 0, hide the Burst and chest and show 'Answer at least 10 cards to keep your streak'.

ranked_findings.where: /app/backend/server.py:233-259 (public_card includes answer) and gamify.py:137 (/rf/cards is public with answers)
ranked_findings.finding: The solo session payload contains every answer key, and /rf/complete accepts any timing (ms is 0 or more and is not checked against the server clock). A script can farm 405 XP and 90 coins per call without limit, which breaks the XP leaderboard. The public /api/rf/cards endpoint also returns answer keys, so duel prompts can be looked up mid-duel.
ranked_findings.fix: Rate-limit rewarded sessions (for example 20 per day). Reject complete calls made sooner than about 1.5 s × answered after session creation. Strip 'answer' from /rf/cards unless an admin key is sent, or apply duel-style per-card answer reveal in solo mode.

ranked_findings.where: /app/frontend/src/sfx.ts (only entry/vs/go sounds); app/rapid/session.tsx:163 and app/rapid/duel.tsx:229 (tap('medium') for every answer)
ranked_findings.finding: Answering is silent: no correct or wrong sound, no combo sound, no timer tick in the last 5 s, no victory, defeat or level-up sound. Haptics are a medium impact whatever the outcome.
ranked_findings.fix: Add sfx for correct, wrong, combo (rising pitch), tick, win, lose and levelup. Use Haptics.notificationAsync(Success or Error) based on the verdict.

ranked_findings.finding: The reward panel is missing: an XP progress bar toward the next level (e.g. 5840 → 6400), the new coin balance, quest progress or a 'Quest ready, claim +30' nudge, personal best or accuracy compared with last time, and a '+1' streak increment with a flame animation. The level-up badge is only a small pill, not a full-screen moment.
ranked_findings.fix: Add an animated XP bar using level_floor and next_level_xp from /rf/profile, a coins balance ticker, a quest-complete chip linking to the claim, and a full-screen level-up overlay with sound.

ranked_findings.finding: The test player moves to the next question 450 ms after an option is picked. That makes the 'How sure are you?' confidence chips under the options almost unusable, and it is unlike the NTA, which never moves you on by itself.
ranked_findings.fix: Remove the auto-advance from the mock or chapter player, or make it an opt-in setting. Never auto-advance while the confidence row is visible.

ranked_findings.finding: At 390 px wide the scanned question image is drawn at about 80 px tall, and its text is unreadable without tapping Zoom. The options say 'Option A (see image)', so students have to keep pinch-zooming.
ranked_findings.fix: Render the image at full width (contentFit=contain, aspect ratio from metadata), trim its whitespace, and allow double-tap to zoom inline.

ranked_findings.finding: 'Start attempt' stays grey until both the device check (2.3-2.8 s upstream) and the acknowledgement checkbox are done. Nothing tells the user the device check is required.
ranked_findings.fix: Run the preflight automatically when the screen mounts. Show inline text such as 'Complete the device check and tick the box to start'. Cache the passed check for 24 h.

ranked_findings.finding: A duel is 30 cards × 20 s, up to 10 minutes, which is too long for a 'Rapid' duel. Students drop out, and forfeits hurt matchmaking.
ranked_findings.fix: Make duels 10 cards (about 3 minutes), with an optional 'Marathon 30'.

ranked_findings.finding: An AI Rival win shows 'Victory! Champion's prize', but bot duels give coins = correct, with no +50 win bonus, and wins are not counted in profile.wins or the Duel record. The hub card promises 'winner takes +50 coins'.
ranked_findings.fix: Change the copy to 'Practice win vs AI Rival' and list the actual bonus, or award a smaller win bonus (+15) for beating a fairly tuned rival.

ranked_findings.finding: Opening /catalogue without slug or kind (deep link or stale route) calls /exam-navigation/undefined/catalogue?kind=undefined, which returns 422, and the screen never loads.
ranked_findings.fix: Guard the missing params: redirect to '/' or show an ErrorBox with 'Choose an exam'.

ranked_findings.finding: profile.sessions is 23 but history.totals.sessions is 32 (shown in the hub as 'RECENT SPRINTS · 32 played'). profile.cards_correct is 457 but solo correct alone is 502, even though the profile also includes duels. Older sessions were never awarded.
ranked_findings.fix: Run a one-off backfill from rf_sessions, or show only one source consistently.

ranked_findings.finding: The next-card 'stack' behind the live card is a flat light-grey slab (surfaceSecondary at 0.8 opacity) on the dark arena. It looks like a skeleton or placeholder rather than a premium card deck.
ranked_findings.fix: Use the dark custom_gameCard colour with a subtle border and gradient, add a second ghost card, and peek about 8 px below.

ranked_findings.finding: The score badge colour comes from the subject, so a perfect 30/30 Maths run shows red and reads as failure, while a 1/10 Physics run shows blue.
ranked_findings.fix: Colour by accuracy (green 80% or more, amber 50% or more, red below), with the subject shown as a small icon.

ranked_findings.where: rapid.tsx quests claim (78x30), chapter chips (36 px tall); attempt confidence chips (36 px)
ranked_findings.finding: These are below the 44 px minimum touch target.
ranked_findings.fix: Set minHeight to 44, or add hitSlop.

ranked_findings.where: rapid.tsx:76 only; session.tsx and duel.tsx use colors.custom_gameBg
ranked_findings.finding: Bought 'Arenas' (themes such as Inferno, Deep Ocean, Royal Gold, described as 'battle arena') only tint the hub background. They are not applied in the solo session or the duel, which is where the store says they apply.
ranked_findings.fix: Apply THEME_BG and the accent colour in session.tsx and duel.tsx.

ranked_findings.finding: After a wrong answer the card moves on in 1.1 s, and the explanation is clamped to 2 lines (numberOfLines=2). The learning moment is lost.
ranked_findings.fix: Keep auto-advance at about 1.1 s for correct answers. For wrong answers, wait about 2.8 s or require Next, and show the full explanation.

ranked_findings.finding: The upstream solution text has PDF hard line breaks in the middle of sentences and has lost its superscripts ('ML-1T -2', 'ε0E2/2'), so it reads like it was cheaply copy-pasted.
ranked_findings.fix: Normalise the whitespace by joining lines that do not end with punctuation or a list marker. Restore superscripts with a small regex for the T-2 and E2 patterns, or render via KaTeX.

ranked_findings.finding: The full solutions payload loads for the Analysis tab. It takes about 425 ms on Wi-Fi but would take several seconds on 3G.
ranked_findings.fix: Load the solutions lazily when the Solutions tab is opened, or request a summary-only variant.

ranked_findings.finding: LogBox showed '<button> cannot contain a nested <button>' on the result Analysis tab in a web session. It did not reproduce on a reload.
ranked_findings.fix: Check for Press components nested inside Chip, Card or Press in the result tabs.

ranked_findings.finding: 11 of the top 20 are shown as 'Player' with no suffix, and TEST_A test data appears 6 times. On the result screen your own name shows as 'Player ··0001' while the duel HUD says 'You'.
ranked_findings.fix: Fall back to 'Player ··'+uid[-4:], purge TEST_ profiles from the leaderboard, and use 'You' consistently.

ranked_findings.finding: fetch calls have no client-side timeout. If the network stalls, the spinner runs until the 30 s proxy timeout, or forever on native, which talks to jeelive.ai directly.
ranked_findings.fix: Add an AbortController with a 12 s timeout and a friendly retry message.

ranked_findings.finding: DefaultCookiePolicy is imported and set twice. An AppState listener does nothing.
ranked_findings.fix: Remove the duplicates. Either pause the card timer while backgrounded or delete the listener.

ranked_findings.finding: 20 prompts appear twice in the same subject (e.g. 'carbylamine reaction is a test for?', 'molarity unit is:'). 142 prompts are under 18 characters ('ⁿPᵣ equals'). 1,019 prompts are noun phrases with no '?', ':' or '='.
ranked_findings.fix: Deduplicate the cards, and normalise prompts to end with '?' or '='.

critical.issue: The rival is rigged to always lose when you score 1 or more, so wins are meaningless.
About 3.7% of sampled cards have a wrong answer key, and about 35 cards have broken 'Both A and B' letter references after shuffling.

minor.issue: Skipping all cards keeps the streak and counts toward the sprint quest. XP can be farmed because answer keys are exposed and timing is not checked.
This public endpoint returns answer keys, which allows mid-duel lookups.
Session and correct counts disagree (23 vs 32 sessions).
Takes 2.3 s upstream and is mandatory before every start.

ui_bugs.issue: Showed the last card's chapter instead of the session's (FIXED by T1).
Calls exam-navigation/undefined, which returns 422, and the screen never loads.

integration_issues.issue: The theme is applied only to the hub, not the session or duel.

issues: The ghost card behind the live card is a light-grey slab
There are no correct or wrong sounds and no outcome-specific haptics
The explanation is clamped to 2 lines and the card moves on after 1.1 s even after a wrong answer
The chest and burst animation plays for a +0 reward
The score line is a small text row ('Player ··0001 9 · 8 Aditya N.'); it should be a large avatar-vs-avatar scoreboard
'Victory! Champion's prize' appears with only +9 coins
Quest claim buttons are 30 px tall and chapter chips 36 px
Recent-sprint badge colours come from the subject rather than the performance
The question image is too small to read
The disabled Start button does not explain why
Solution text has PDF hard line breaks and lost superscripts

action_items: HIGH: Make the AI Rival fair and adaptive (duels.py simulate_bot and winner), aiming for a 55-65% human win rate.

HIGH: Run blind LLM re-verification of all 11,498 rf_cards and quarantine any card where it disagrees with the key. Fix the 2 confirmed wrong keys (circle touching the y-axis should be f²=c; the lanthanoid +4 card should be Tb). Rewrite the ~35 'Both A and B' / 'All of these' options.
MEDIUM: Give streak, quest and session credit only when 10 or more cards are answered. Hide the celebration for a 0 reward.
MEDIUM: Close the XP farming route by stripping answers from /rf/cards, adding a minimum-duration check and a daily cap on rewarded sessions.
MEDIUM: Add answer, combo, tick, win, lose and level-up sounds, plus success and error haptics.
MEDIUM: Enrich the RewardPanel: animated XP-to-next-level bar, coin balance, quest-ready chip, full-screen level-up.
MEDIUM: Remove the 450 ms auto-advance in attempt/[id].tsx:177 and enlarge the question images.
MEDIUM: Run the set preflight automatically and explain the disabled Start button.
MEDIUM: Shorten duels to 10 cards. Align the AI Rival reward copy and bonus.

LOW: Guard catalogue params; theme the session and duel screens; raise touch targets to 44 px; colour sprint badges by accuracy; normalise solution text; lazy-load solutions; add a fetch timeout; tidy the leaderboard names and purge TEST_ data; deduplicate the 20 duplicate prompts; backfill the profile and history counts.
critical_code_review_comments: duels.py:127 docstring says the rival 'always stays below the student's score'. This is intentional, but it destroys competitive fun.

Solo answer keys are sent to the client (server.py:233), and correctness is also computed on the client (session.tsx:166). The server re-derives correctness, which is good, but it does not validate timing.
gamify.award treats every completed session as a sprint, regardless of how many cards were answered.
test_rf_avatars_entries.py::TestDuelStart depends on test order (it assumes an earlier equip of entry_blackhole) and fails under xdist or in isolation.
server.py duplicates the DefaultCookiePolicy import and the set_policy call.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/rapid/session.tsx (line 202: summary header uses the session's chapter or 'Mixed chapters')

success_rate.backend: 100% (52/52 serial; 1 order-dependent flaky test under xdist)
success_rate.frontend: All screens load and all flows complete; 26 audit findings

Run pytest serially (-p no:randomly, no -n) for a clean 52/52.
